faq.q1: Is the stock on the website up to date?
faq.a1: Almost live. The website syncs stock with the tills of both stores every ten minutes and checks it again on the product page and before you send. If an item has just been sold in store, we tell you before you reserve or pay.
faq.a2: Nothing, and you commit to nothing. If something does not fit, simply leave it in the store.
faq.q3: How long is an item reserved?
faq.a3: {n} working days from the collection date you choose. After that, the item goes back on sale.
faq.q4: Can I reserve at one store and collect at the other?
faq.a4: We are still clarifying this with the stores.
faq.q6: Can I return or exchange items?
faq.a6: You can return items bought online within 14 days (right of withdrawal, see the withdrawal information).
faq.q7: Is a gift voucher valid in both stores?
faq.a7: Yes, at Confection Lanners and at Jager-Oberlinkels. You redeem it in store.

datenschutz.intro: This page explains which data we use for reservations, orders and requests, why, for how long, and which rights you have.
datenschutz.verantwortlich: The controller is the store where you reserve, order or send a request. Who operates the website as a whole has not yet been decided.
datenschutz.reservierung: We use your first name, last name, email address, mobile number, the collection date you choose, your note and the reserved items. This lets the store keep the items for you and reach you if something goes wrong. The reservation is stored in the store's till system. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time.
datenschutz.bestellung: We use your contact details, the delivery and billing address, the items ordered and the payment reference. Without these details we cannot fulfil the sales contract. The legal basis is the performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); the store keeps receipts as required by law (point c). You enter your payment details only with the payment provider; we do not see them.
datenschutz.anfrage: When you write to us via the contact form, we use your name, email address or phone number and your message to reply. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
datenschutz.empfaengerSofttouch: SoftTouch, provider of the stores' till system (Belgium)
datenschutz.empfaengerSupabase: Supabase, database and server functions of this website (data centre in the EU)
datenschutz.empfaengerZahlung: the payment provider for online orders
datenschutz.empfaengerHosting: GitHub Pages, hosting of the pages
datenschutz.fristenReservierung: Reservations: 30 days after the collection date, then anonymised
datenschutz.fristenBestellung: Orders: 90 days after completion, then anonymised; receipts are kept in the store's till system
datenschutz.fristenJob: A daily job anonymises and deletes the data after these periods.
datenschutz.cookies: This website sets no cookies and does not measure visits. Your basket and the chosen store are kept only in your browser (localStorage), because you use these functions. After an error in a form, your browser briefly keeps your entries (sessionStorage) so you do not have to type everything again. To protect against too many requests, your IP address is used only as a checksum and is not stored.
datenschutz.extern: Fonts are hosted on this website, with no connection to Google. Links to Google Maps (“Get directions”), Facebook and Letzshop only open the service when you click them.
datenschutz.maps: On the store pages you can load a map from Google Maps. Your browser only connects to Google (Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland) when you click “Load map”. Google then receives, among other things, your IP address and the address of the page; Google may set cookies and transfer data to the USA. The legal basis is your consent given by the click (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR); it only applies to this page view. Without a click, nothing is sent to Google.
datenschutz.rechte: You can ask for access to your data, have it corrected, deleted or restricted, object to processing, ask for it to be transferred and withdraw consent at any time. Write to the store to do so. You can also complain to the CNPD, the data protection authority in Luxembourg.
